title: Analytics
description: Your habits, tasks and goals, counted from your own records.
running: This period is still running; the numbers show it up to today.

habitRate.label: Habit completion
habitRate.empty: No habits were due in this period
habitRate.explain: Completed days divided by due days. Skipped and postponed days, and a today that is still open, are not counted.

tasks.label: Tasks completed
tasks.explain: Tasks finished on a day of this period.

onTime.label: Tasks finished on time
onTime.detail: {{done}} of {{total}} tasks with a due date
onTime.empty: No task with a due date was finished
onTime.explain: Tasks finished on or before their due date, divided by all finished tasks that had a due date.

goals.label: Milestones completed
goals.explain: Milestones and goals marked as completed during this period.

change.up: {{value}} points more than the previous period
change.down: {{value}} points less than the previous period
change.noPrevious: Nothing to compare in the previous period

habits.title: Habit completion rate
habits.explain: Each bar shows the share of due habit days that were completed in that step. Steps without any due habit are empty.
habits.caption: Due and completed habit days in each step of the period

tasks.title: Tasks completed
tasks.explain: Each bar shows how many tasks were finished in that step.
tasks.caption: Tasks finished in each step of the period

weekday.title: By day of the week
weekday.explain: The share of habit days that were completed on each weekday of this period. It shows which days come easily and which do not.
weekday.caption: Due and completed habit days by weekday

habits.title: Habits
habits.description: How each habit did in this period, next to the period before.
habits.empty: No habit was active in this period
habits.name: Habit

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: A breakdown of the tasks you finished in this period.
tasks.empty: No task was finished in this period

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Your active goals and where they stand against the time that has passed.
goals.paceRule: Progress is compared with the share of the time from start to target date that has passed. Within ten points it is “On track”, above that “Ahead”, below that “Behind”.

highlights.title: Period report
highlights.description: What stands out in this period. Each line comes from a fixed rule.
highlights.empty: There is not enough data in this period to point anything out.

habit_rate_up.text: Your habit completion rate rose by {{points}} points over the previous period.
habit_rate_up.rule: Shown when both periods have at least 5 days that could be judged and the difference is at least 5 points.

habit_rate_down.text: Your habit completion rate fell by {{points}} points from the previous period.
habit_rate_down.rule: Shown when both periods have at least 5 days that could be judged and the difference is at least 5 points.

top_habit.rule: The highest rate among habits with at least 3 days that could be judged; shown when it is at least 80%.

struggling_habit.text: {{name}} had a hard time this period: {{percent}}%, missed {{missed}} times.
struggling_habit.rule: The lowest rate among habits with at least 3 days that could be judged and a rate below 50%.

best_weekday.rule: The highest rate among weekdays with at least 3 habit days; shown when the best and weakest day are at least 15 points apart.

weakest_weekday.rule: The lowest rate among weekdays with at least 3 habit days; shown when the best and weakest day are at least 15 points apart.

tasks_on_time.text: You finished {{onTime}} of {{total}} tasks with a due date on time ({{percent}}%).
tasks_on_time.rule: Shown when at least 5 tasks with a due date were finished in this period.

tasks_completed_up.text: You finished {{count}} more tasks than in the previous period ({{completed}} in total).
tasks_completed_up.rule: Only finished periods are compared; a running period always looks behind.

tasks_completed_down.text: You finished {{count}} fewer tasks than in the previous period ({{completed}} in total).
tasks_completed_down.rule: Only finished periods are compared; a running period always looks behind.

most_productive_day.text: You finished the most tasks on {{date}}: {{count}} tasks.
most_productive_day.rule: The single day with the most finished tasks; shown when at least 3 tasks were finished that day.

goals_completed.text_one: You completed {{count}} goal in this period.
goals_completed.text_other: You completed {{count}} goals in this period.
goals_completed.rule: Goals whose completion time falls in this period.

milestones_completed.text_one: You reached {{count}} milestone in this period.
milestones_completed.text_other: You reached {{count}} milestones in this period.
milestones_completed.rule: Milestones whose completion time falls in this period.
